name: Washed Ashore
summary: Along Darkshore's misty coast, dead sea creatures have drawn Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde into a troubling inquiry. She serves the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus and seeks to learn why marine life is stranding or dying along the shore.

sections.title: A Disturbing Tide
sections.body: Dead sea creatures line Darkshore's beaches and shallows, puzzling the night elves of Auberdine. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde has already examined one stranded creature along the beach. Now she asks you to dive west of the docks, near a sunken vessel, and inspect the bones of a massive sea turtle. The evidence will help her report to the Temple of the Moon.

sections.title: Flight from the World Tree
sections.body: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde hopes to gather enough physical evidence for a formal report to the Priestesses of Elune in Darnassus. Her early findings suggest the sea creatures may be fleeing something in the open sea. That danger could lie in the waters around Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are sea creatures washing ashore in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The cause remains unknown. Gwennyth needs samples from the stranded creatures to report to the Temple of the Moon and continue her research.
Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a night elf researcher in Auberdine who reports to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She is recording the wave of dead and beached sea creatures along Darkshore's coast.

faq.q: Where is the skeletal sea turtle located?
faq.answer: The skeletal sea turtle lies on the ocean floor due west of Auberdine's docks, near the wreckage of a sunken vessel off Darkshore's coast.

faq.q: What does the Temple of the Moon have to do with this?
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon directs night elf ecological and spiritual matters. Gwennyth needs physical samples for a formal report to the priestesses about the strange die-off.

faq.q: Are there more beached creatures to find?
faq.answer: Yes. Gwennyth says beached creatures lie along the Darkshore coastline, and asks you to search the sands for remains from other stranded behemoths.

faq.q: What is the difference between the two 'Washed Ashore' quests?
faq.answer: The first Washed Ashore sends you to examine a creature stranded on a nearby beach. The follow-up asks you to swim west of the docks and inspect a submerged skeletal sea turtle.

angles.text: As a druid, you may read the mass deaths and erratic flight of Darkshore's ancient sea creatures as signs of corruption or a disruption in nature's balance around Teldrassil.
As a priest, you support the Priestesses of Elune at the Temple of the Moon, who oversee the spiritual and natural well-being of northern Kalimdor.
As a night elf, you know Auberdine as the gateway between Teldrassil and the mainland. Evidence that ocean life is fleeing your new home is a troubling omen.
